paite: Aigupta gam puakgik. Ngai in, TOUPA meipi hattak tung a tuang in, Aigupta gam ahong tungta, Aigupta gam milimte ama ah aling vonvon ding ua, Aiguptate lungtang lah asung uah azulmang mai ding hi.
heading: Pathian In Aigupta Agawt Ding
english: The burden of Egypt: “Behold, Yahweh rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt will melt in its midst.

paite: Aigupta mite Aigupta mite mah sual ding in ka tokthou ding a; huchi in michih in amau unau sual in michih in amau invengte sual in, akidou ding uh; khua leh khua akidou ding ua, gam leh gam akidou ding uhi.
english: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

paite: Huchi in Aiguptate kha asung uah bangmah lou a bawl in a-om ding a; athusawm uh ka hihse ding; huchi in milimte leh bumsiamte thu adong ding uhi.
english: The spirit of Egypt will fail in its midst. I will destroy its counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.

paite: Aigupta mite heutu tatsetak khut ah ka pekhe ding a; huchi in kumpipa hangsan in atung uah vai ahawmta ding, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Tuipi tuite akang ding ua, luite luangmang in akangtatta ding.
english: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.

paite: Luite anamsia ua; Aigupta gam tui luangte akiam hiaihiai ding ua, akangtat ding a; phailuangte leh tui loupate avuai khin ding uh.
english: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.

paite: Nile lui kiang a Nile lui gei mahmah a, gantatna pawnte leh Nile lui kiang a thil chin tengtengte ahong keu vek ding a, taihmang in a-om ding a, a-om nawn kei ding hi.
english: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.

paite: Ngaman mite leng akap ding ua, Nile lui a ngakuai khaimi tengteng in a-awm uh akitum ding ua, tui a lenpi zakte athadahgawpta ding uhi.
english: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.

paite: Huai lou in leng ziza hiahsiang khoih mite leh puanngou gan mite azahlak ding uhi.
english: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.

paite: Akingakna pipen hihzan in a-om ding a, kiloh mite alungkham ding uh.
english: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.

paite: Zoan a miliante ahai ding ua, Pharaoh mipilpente lemtheihnasa lemtheihna bang lel ahong hita. Pharaoh kiang ah, mipil tapa, nidanglai kumpipate tapa ka hi, bangchidan a chi sek na hi ua?
english: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?”

paite: Na mipilte koi a om ahi ua? Amau hon hilh pah ngal uhen; Aigupta gam tung a thil tung ding, sepaihte' TOUPA sehte, thei uhen.
english: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what Yahweh of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.

paite: Zoan a vaihawm miliante mihai ahong hita ua, Memphis a vaihawm miliante khem in a-omta uh; Aigupta namte ning a suangte'n Aiguptate avakmangsakta hi.
english: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, who are the cornerstone of her tribes.

paite: TOUPA'N Aiguptate lak ah phengphitna kha a-omsakta; huchi in zukhammi aluak a ahoi doidoi bang in Aiguptate anasep chiteng uah apaikawisakta uhi.
english: Yahweh has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the midst of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

paite: Aiguptate a ding in lutang in hiam, mei in hiam, tumnah hiang in hiam, pumpeng in hiam a sepsak theih a-om nawnta kei ding hi.
english: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Aigupta numeite bang ahi ding ua; Sepaihte' TOUPA khut sin atung ua akisin ziak in aling un alau ding uhi.
heading: Aigupta In TOUPA Abe Ding
english: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the hand of Yahweh of Armies, which he shakes over them.

paite: Judah gam a omte Aiguptate a ding in mulkimhuaitak ahong hita ding ua, amin uh alohna peuh uah akihta ding ua, amau tung atung ding sepaihte' TOUPA thuhilhna ziak in.
english: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of Yahweh of Armies, which he determines against it.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Kanaante pau a pau leh sepaihte' TOUPA kiang ah kichiamna thuchiam sekte, Aigupta gamsung ah kho nga a-om ding a; khat tuh Ni Khopi achi ding uhi.
english: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahweh of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”

paite: Huai ni chiang in Aigupta laitak ah TOUPA a ding in maitam a-om ding a, agamgi ah TOUPA a ding in suangphuh a-om ding hi.
english: In that day, there will be an altar to Yahweh in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Yahweh at its border.

paite: Huai Aigupta gam a sepaihte' TOUPA a ding in chiamtehna leh theihna ahi ding; nuaisiahte ziak in TOUPA asam ding uhi, huchi in ama'n hondampa leh humbitpa asawl ding a, ama'n amaute ahunkhe ding hi.
english: It will be for a sign and for a witness to Yahweh of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to Yahweh because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA tuh Aiguptate theih ahita ding a, Aigupta mite'n huai ni chiang in TOUPA atheita ding uh; ahi, kithoihna leh thilpiak in abe ding ua, TOUPA kiang ah thu achiam ding ua, atangtun lai ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know Yahweh in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to Yahweh, and will perform it.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Aiguptate avo ding a, avo ding a, ahihdam lai ding; huchi in TOUPA kiang ah akik nawn ding ua, ama'n angetnate za in amaute ahihdam ding hi.
english: Yahweh will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to Yahweh, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Aigupta gam a kipan in Assuria gam pha in lamlian a-om ding a; huchi in Assuria mite Aigupta gam ah ahoh ding uh; Aigupta leng Assuria gam ah ahoh ding uh. Aigupta mite'n Assuria mite toh Pathian abekhawmta ding uhi.
english: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Israelte Aiguptate leh Assuriate toh athumna ahi ding ua, lei laizangtak ah vualzawlna ahi ding uh.
english: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth;

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, ka mi Aiguptate leh ka khutsuak Assuriate leh ka goutan Israelte vualzawl in om uhen, chi in avualzawl hi.
english: because Yahweh of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”
